name: In Search of The Temple

aliases: who gives in search of the temple
who sends you to find the temple
faq.answer: Brohann Caskbelly gives this request from within the city of Stormwind.
faq.q: Who asks you to find the temple?

aliases: what place are you looking for
where is the temple of atalhakkar
faq.answer: Brohann Caskbelly asks you to search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
faq.q: What temple are you searching for?

faq.answer: Brohann Caskbelly is stationed in the human capital of Stormwind.

sections.body: Brohann Caskbelly waits in the city of Stormwind with an inquiry concerning distant lands. He needs a traveler willing to seek out the elusive Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Whether the ancient site still stands or what dangers linger around it remains unknown.
sections.title: A Search from Stormwind

summary: In Stormwind, Brohann Caskbelly seeks someone to scout for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Finding the ancient structure means venturing far beyond the city walls to discover what remains of it.
attribution: In-game quest text: In Search of The Temple
